verdicts.reason: A: HOHOHO and AGENCY are pushed far apart by a big empty gap, so the brand name no longer reads as one unit. The original's decorative shapes are shrunk into a jumbled strip of tiny fragments squeezed beside HOHOHO. The cut-off blue ring and the stray triangle and dot float in a mostly empty lower half. B: still broken, with the same tiny, crowded shape strip, a clipped blue ring with its wavy lines, and an empty right-hand area in the bottom half. Still, it keeps HOHOHO, AGENCY and the tagline in a tighter, left-aligned group, so the hierarchy and reading order hold up better than in A.
